# free5GC-helm

[![Helm charts linting](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/actions/workflows/helm-charts-testing.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/actions/workflows/helm-charts-testing.yml)
[![CNTi essential](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/raw/badges/cnti-badge.svg)](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-helm/actions/workflows/cnti.yml)

***free5gc-helm*** is an open-source project implemented to provide helm charts in order to deploy on one click a 5G system (RAN+SA 5G core) on top of Kubernetes. It currently relies on free5GC for the core network and free-ran-ue or UERANSIM to simulate Radio Access Network.

## Documentation
The documentation is available on the [free5GC official site](https://free5gc.org/guide/7-free5gc-helm/).

## Motivations
Please consult this [link](/motivations.md) to see the motivations that have led to this project.

## Contributing
Moving towards a Cloud native model for the 5G system is not a simple task. We welcome all new [contributions](./CONTRIBUTING.md) making this project better!

## Acknowledgement
Thanks to both Free5GC and UERANSIM teams for their great efforts.

## License
***free5gc-helm*** is under [Apache 2.0](./LICENSE) license.

# Setup free5gc on one single cluster and test with UERANSIM

This guideline shows how to deploy the free5gc on a Kubernetes cluster and then test it with UERANSIM. 



## Prerequisites
 - A Kubernetes cluster supporting SCTP
 - Kubernetes worker nodes with kernel 5.0.0-23-generic and containing gtp5g kernel module ([required for the Free5GC UPF element](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc/wiki/Installation#a-prerequisites)).
 - [Multus-CNI](https://github.com/intel/multus-cni).
 - [Helm3](https://helm.sh/docs/intro/install/).
 - [Kubectl](https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/tools/install-kubectl/) (optional).
 - A Persistent Volume (size 8Gi). 
 - A physical network interface on each Kubernetes node named eth0.
 - A physical network interface on each Kubernetes node named eth1 to connect the UPF to the Data Network.


**Note:** If the names of network interfaces on your Kubernetes nodes are different from `eth0` and `eth1`, see [Networks configuration](#networks-configuration).

## Networks configuration
Please refer to this section [Networks configuration](https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/towards5gs-helm/tree/main/charts/free5gc#networks-configuration) to make sure you'll not have a networking related issue.

## Steps

### Install gtp5g kernel module
First check that the Linux kernel version on Kubernetes worker nodes is `5.0.0-23-generic` or `5.4.x`. 
```console
uname -r
```

Then, on each worker node, install the [gtp5g kernel module](https://github.com/free5gc/gtp5g). 
```console
git clone -b v0.3.1 https://github.com/free5gc/gtp5g.git
cd gtp5g
make
sudo make install
```


### Create a Persistent Volume
If you don't have a Persistent Volume provisioner, you can use the following commands to create a namespace for the project and a [Persistent Volume](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/storage/persistent-volumes/) within this namespace that will be consumed by MongoDB by adapting it to your implementation (you have to replace `worker1` by the name of the node and `/home/vagrant/kubedata` by the right directory on this node in which you want to persist the MongoDB data).
```console
kubectl create ns <namespace>
cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolume
metadata:
  name: example-local-pv9
  labels:
    project: free5gc
spec:
  capacity:
    storage: 8Gi
  accessModes:
  - ReadWriteOnce
  persistentVolumeReclaimPolicy: Retain
  local:
    path: /home/vagrant/kubedata
  nodeAffinity:
    required:
      nodeSelectorTerms:
      - matchExpressions:
        - key: kubernetes.io/hostname
          operator: In
          values:
          - worker1
EOF
```
**NOTE:** you must create the folder on the right node before creating the Peristent Volume.

### Deploy Free5GC
#### Install the Free5GC Helm chart
On the [charts](../../charts) directory, run:
```console
helm -n <namespace> install <free5GC-release-name> ./free5gc/
```

#### Check the state of the created pods
```console
kubectl -n <namespace> get pods -l "project=free5gc"
```

#### Add user information
The WebUI uses a `ClusterIP` service by default. To access it locally, run:

```console
kubectl -n <namespace> port-forward svc/webui-service 5000:5000
```

Open http://127.0.0.1:5000 while port-forward is running.

If you prefer NodePort access, set `free5gc-webui.webui.service.type=NodePort` when installing or upgrading the free5gc umbrella chart (for example, add `--set free5gc-webui.webui.service.type=NodePort` to the Helm command).
The default node port is `30500`. Then follow the original instructions below:

The WEBUI can is exposed with a Kubernetes service with `nodePort=30500`. So you can access it by using this url `{replace-by-the-IP-of-one-of-your-cluster-nodes}:30500`.

For adding a new subscriber, please refer to the [Free5GC documentation](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc/wiki/New-Subscriber-via-webconsole#4-use-browser-to-connect-to-webconsole).


### Test with UERANSIM
#### Install the UERANSIM Helm chart
On the [charts](../../charts) directory, run:
```console
helm -n <namespace> install <UERANSIM-release-name> ./ueransim/
```
#### Check the state of the created pods
```console
kubectl -n <namespace> get pods -l "app=ueransim"
```

#### Test with the TUN interface
Once the UERANSIM components created, you can access to the UE pod by running:
```console
kubectl -n <namespace> exec -it <ue-pod-name> -- bash
```
Then, you can use the created TUN interface for more advanced testing. Please refer to the UERANSIM helm chart's [README](../../charts/ueransim) and check this [link](https://github.com/aligungr/UERANSIM/wiki/)  and the [UERANSIM chart Readme](/charts/ueransim) for more details.
```console
# Run this inside the container
ip address 
...
5: uesimtun0: <POINTOPOINT,MULTICAST,NOARP,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1500 qdisc fq_codel state UNKNOWN group default qlen 500
    link/none 
    inet 10.1.0.1/32 scope global uesimtun0
       valid_lft forever preferred_lft forever

ping -I uesimtun0 www.google.com
traceroute -i uesimtun0 www.google.com
curl --interface uesimtun0 www.google.com
```

## Advanced configuration
Check the readme of each Helm chart in the project to list configurable parameters.

## Troubleshooting
### Clean MongoDB
According to the [Free5GC documentation](https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc/wiki), you may sometimes need to drop the data stored in the MongoDB. To do so with our implementation, you need simply to empty the folder that was used in the Persistent Volume on the corresponding node.
```console
sudo rm -rf {path-to-folder}/*
```
### TUN interface correctly created on the UE but internet 
This may occur because of `ipv4.ip_forward` being disabled on the UPF POD. In fact, this functionalty is needed by the UPF as it allows him to [act as a router](http://linux-ip.net/html/routing-forwarding.html).

To check if it is enabled, run this command on the UPF POD. The result must be 1.
```console
cat /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_forward
```
We remind you that some CNI plugins (e.g. [Flannel](https://github.com/flannel-io/flannel)) allow this functionality by default, while others (.e.g. [Calico](https://github.com/projectcalico/cni-plugin)) require a [special configuration](https://docs.projectcalico.org/reference/host-endpoints/forwarded).

### Promiscuous mode
[Promiscuous mode](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Promiscuous_mode) must be enabled for master interfaces of MACVLAN interfaces. In fact, allows network interfaces to intercept packets even if the MAC destination address on these packets is different from the MAC address of this interface. This is necesary as MACVLAN interfaces we are using will have diffrent MAC addresses from MAC addresses of their master interfaces.

**NOTE:** how to enable Promiscuous highly depends on the technology or the tool used for the creation of VMs. Thus, you should check if it is enabled by default in your platform or how to enable it.

https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/towards5gs-helm/issues/6#issuecomment-952618212


## Reference
 - https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc/wiki
 - https://github.com/free5gc/free5gc-compose
 - https://github.com/aligungr/UERANSIM/wiki/Usage#using-the-tun-interface
 - https://docs.projectcalico.org/about/about-calico

#
# Software Name : towards5gs-helm
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) 2021 Orange
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# This software is distributed under the Apache License 2.0,
# the text of which is available at https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/towards5gs-helm/blob/main/LICENSE
# or see the "LICENSE" file for more details.
#
# Author: Abderaouf KHICHANE, Ilhem FAJJARI, Ayoub BOUSSELMI, Ian Chen
# Software description: An open-source project providing Helm charts to deploy 5G components (Core + RAN) on top of Kubernetes
#
# Default values for free5gcControlPlane chart.
# This is a YAML-formatted file.
# Declare variables to be passed into your templates.

nameOverride: ""
fullnameOverride: ""

global:
  projectName: free5gc
  userPlaneArchitecture: single  # possible values are "single" and "ulcl"
  uesubnet: 10.60.0.0/16  # UE IP address pool
  nrf:
    service:
      name: nrf-nnrf
      type: ClusterIP
      port: "8000"
      nodePort: "30800"
  sbi:
    scheme: http
  smf:
    multus:
      enabled: false
      n4if:  # PFCP interface (used when multus.enabled=true)
        ipAddress: 10.100.50.244
      n4network:
        enabled: true
        name: n4network
        type: ipvlan
        masterIf: eth0
        subnetIP: 10.100.50.240
        cidr: 29
        gatewayIP: 10.100.50.246
        excludeIP: 10.100.50.246

initcontainers:
  curl:
    registry: curlimages
    image: curl
    tag: "8.7.1"
  busybox:
    image: busybox
    tag: "1.32.0"

isPfcpNeeded: true

smf:
  name: smf
  replicaCount: 1
  image:
    name: free5gc/smf
    tag: v4.3.0
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: &Port 8080
  volume:
    mount: /free5gc/config/
    tlsmount: /free5gc/config/TLS
    certmount: /free5gc/cert
  podAnnotations: {}
    # additional annotations
  imagePullSecrets: []
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsUser: 1000
    runAsGroup: 1000
    runAsNonRoot: true
    fsGroup: 1000
    seccompProfile:
      type: RuntimeDefault
  securityContext:
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
    limits:
      cpu: 200m
      memory: 256Mi
  readinessProbe:
    enabled: true
    exec:
      command:
        - /bin/sh
        - -c
        - |
          HEX_PORT=$(printf '%04X' "{{ .service.port }}")
          grep -q ":${HEX_PORT} .* 0A " /proc/net/tcp || grep -q ":${HEX_PORT} .* 0A " /proc/net/tcp6
    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 1
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold: 40
    successThreshold: 1
  livenessProbe:
    enabled: true
    exec:
      command:
        - /bin/sh
        - -c
        - |
          HEX_PORT=$(printf '%04X' "{{ .service.port }}")
          grep -q ":${HEX_PORT} .* 0A " /proc/net/tcp || grep -q ":${HEX_PORT} .* 0A " /proc/net/tcp6
    initialDelaySeconds: 50
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 10
    failureThreshold: 3
    successThreshold: 1
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}
  autoscaling:
    enabled: false
    minReplicas: 1
    maxReplicas: 100
    targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 80
    # targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage: 80
  ingress:
    enabled: false
    annotations: {}
      # kubernetes.io/ingress.class: nginx
      # kubernetes.io/tls-acme: "true"
    hosts:
      - host: chart-example.local
        paths: []
    tls: []
    #  - secretName: chart-example-tls
    #    hosts:
    #      - chart-example.local
  configuration:
    sbi:
      tls:
        verify: false # Verify outgoing SBI HTTPS certificates
    serviceNameList: |-
        - nsmf-pdusession
        - nsmf-event-exposure
        - nsmf-oam
    urrConfiguration: |-
      urrPeriod: 10 # default usage report period in seconds
      urrThreshold: 1000 # default usage report threshold in bytes
      requestedUnit: 1000
    configuration: |-
      smfName: SMF
      snssaiInfos:
        - sNssai:
            sst: 1
            sd: 010203
          dnnInfos: # DNN information list
            - dnn: internet # Data Network Name
              dnaiList:
                - mec
              dns: # the IP address of DNS
                ipv4: 8.8.8.8
                ipv6: 2001:4860:4860::8888
      plmnList: # the list of PLMN IDs that this SMF belongs to

{{- if eq .Values.global.userPlaneArchitecture "single" }}
{{- with .Values.upf }}
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "free5gc-upf.fullname" $ }}-{{ .name }}-configmap
  labels:
    app: {{ $.Values.global.projectName }}
data:
  upfcfg.yaml: |
    version: 1.0.3
    description: UPF initial local configuration

    # The listen IP and nodeID of the N4 interface on this UPF (Can't set to 0.0.0.0)
    pfcp:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
      addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n4if.ipAddress }} # IP addr for listening
      nodeID: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n4if.ipAddress }} # External IP or FQDN can be reached
{{- else }}
      addr: POD_IP_ADDR # IP addr for listening - replaced at runtime
      nodeID: POD_IP_ADDR # External IP or FQDN can be reached - replaced at runtime
{{- end }}
      retransTimeout: 1s # retransmission timeout
      maxRetrans: 3 # the max number of retransmission

    gtpu:
      forwarder: gtp5g
      # The IP list of the N3/N9 interfaces on this UPF
      # If there are multiple connection, set addr to 0.0.0.0 or list all the addresses
      ifList:
{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
        - addr: {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.upf.n3if.ipAddress }}
          type: N3
{{- else }}
        - addr: POD_IP_ADDR
          type: N3
{{- end }}
          # name: upf.5gc.nctu.me
          # ifname: gtpif

    {{- toYaml .configuration | nindent 4 }}

  wrapper.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    set -e

{{- if $.Values.global.upf.multus.enabled }}
    # Multus mode: Static IPs and dedicated interfaces are configured
    echo "[wrapper] Multus mode enabled - using dedicated interfaces"
    
    # Setup networking rules
    iptables -A FORWARD -j ACCEPT
    iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} -o n6 -j MASQUERADE
    echo "1200 n6if" >> /etc/iproute2/rt_tables
    ip rule add from {{ $.Values.global.uesubnet }} table n6if
    ip route add default via {{ $.Values.global.upf.multus.n6network.gatewayIP }} dev n6 table n6if

    {{- if $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}

    exec /free5gc/upf -c {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml
{{- else }}
    # Dynamic Pod IP mode: Single interface (eth0)
    # Get Pod IP dynamically
    POD_IP=$(hostname -i | awk '{print $1}')
    echo "[wrapper] UPF Pod IP detected: $POD_IP"

    # Copy config to writable location
    cp {{ .volume.mount }}/upfcfg.yaml /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    # Replace POD_IP_ADDR placeholder with actual Pod IP
    sed -i "s/POD_IP_ADDR/$POD_IP/g" /tmp/upfcfg.yaml

    echo "[wrapper] UPF PFCP config:"
    cat /tmp/upfcfg.yaml | grep -A3 "pfcp:"

    # Wait for upfgtp interface to be created by gtp5g module
    echo "[wrapper] Waiting for upfgtp interface..."
    for i in $(seq 1 30); do
      if ip link show upfgtp > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[wrapper] upfgtp interface is ready"
        break
      fi
      sleep 1
    done

    {{- if $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands }}
    {{- $.Values.upf.configmap.wrapperAdditionalCommands | nindent 4 }}
    {{- end }}

    echo "[wrapper] Starting UPF with dynamic config"
    exec /free5gc/upf -c /tmp/upfcfg.yaml
{{- end }}

{{- end }}
{{- end }}

content.text: MongoDB 那邊的覆寫很清楚：清空 `mongodb.extraDeploy`，並把 `mongodb.persistence.storageClass` 改成 K3s 預設的 `local-path`。更新 values 後安裝 free5GC。

input.command:
cat > /home/vagrant/work/deploy/values-free5gc.yaml <<'EOF'
# Overrides for free5gc-helm umbrella chart (free5GC v4.3.0)
# - single UPF, PLMN 208/93, slice SST1/SD010203, DNN "internet" (chart defaults already match)
global:
  userPlaneArchitecture: single
  uesubnet: 10.60.0.0/16
deployN3iwf: false
deployDbPython: false
mongodb:
  # Chart ships a hard-coded PV for microk8s/node "free5gc"; drop it and use K3s local-path dynamic provisioning
  extraDeploy: []
  persistence:
    storageClass: "local-path"
    size: 6Gi
EOF
cd /home/vagrant/work && helm template free5gc /tmp/free5gc-helm/charts/free5gc -n free5gc -f deploy/values-free5gc.yaml > deploy/free5gc-rendered.yaml && grep -c "pv-mongo" deploy/free5gc-rendered.yaml; grep -n "storageClassName" deploy/free5gc-rendered.yaml; kubectl create namespace free5gc 2>&1; helm install free5gc /tmp/free5gc-helm/charts/free5gc -n free5gc -f deploy/values-free5gc.yaml --timeout 10m 2>&1 | tail -20

content.text: 根因找到了：UPF 的 `natIfCIDR` 預設是 `192.168.0.0/16`，但 Pod 網路是 `10.42.0.0/16`，UPF 找不到對應網卡。把它改成 Pod CIDR，並用 `helm upgrade` 套用（DNN 清單整個覆寫，保留 cidr 與 ipForwardEnable）。

input.command:
cat >> /home/vagrant/work/deploy/values-free5gc.yaml <<'EOF'
upf:
  configuration:
    dnnList:
      - dnn: internet
        cidr: 10.60.0.0/16
        # UPF picks the NAT egress interface by address: must match the pod network (flannel 10.42.0.0/16), not the chart default 192.168.0.0/16
        natIfCIDR: 10.42.0.0/16
        ipForwardEnable: true
    logger:
      enable: true
      level: info
      reportCaller: false
EOF
cd /home/vagrant/work && helm upgrade free5gc /tmp/free5gc-helm/charts/free5gc -n free5gc -f deploy/values-free5gc.yaml --timeout 10m 2>&1 | grep -E "STATUS|REVISION|Error" ; timeout 200 kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready pod -l nf=upf -n free5gc --timeout=180s 2>&1 | tail -3; kubectl get pods -n free5gc 2>&1

2. **我的 UPF override 沒生效**：umbrella chart 的子 chart 覆寫要寫在 `free5gc-upf:` 底下，我寫成頂層 `upf:`，所以 configmap 沒變。

# Overrides for free5gc-helm umbrella chart (free5GC v4.3.0)
# - single UPF, PLMN 208/93, slice SST1/SD010203, DNN "internet" (chart defaults already match)
global:
  userPlaneArchitecture: single
  uesubnet: 10.60.0.0/16
deployN3iwf: false
deployDbPython: false
mongodb:
  # Chart ships a hard-coded PV for microk8s/node "free5gc"; drop it and use K3s local-path dynamic provisioning
  extraDeploy: []
  persistence:
    storageClass: "local-path"
    size: 6Gi
# Subchart values must be nested under the dependency name (free5gc-upf), not top-level
free5gc-upf:
  upf:
    configuration:
      dnnList:
        - dnn: internet
          cidr: 10.60.0.0/16
          # UPF picks the NAT egress interface by address: must match the pod network (flannel 10.42.0.0/16), not the chart default 192.168.0.0/16
          natIfCIDR: 10.42.0.0/16
          ipForwardEnable: true
      logger:
        enable: true
        level: info
        reportCaller: false
EOF

剩下的阻塞是 Docker Hub 額度。我寫一個背景腳本：每 5 分鐘嘗試一次拉取，遇到 429 就整輪停下，不再消耗額度；拉成功的映像會直接放進 K3s 的 containerd。核心 NF（AMF/AUSF/UDM/UDR/PCF/SMF）和 UERANSIM 是必要的，BSF/CHF/NEF 不影響註冊和 PDU session，排在後面。

cat > /home/vagrant/work/deploy/pull-images.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Retry pulling free5GC/UERANSIM images into K3s containerd while Docker Hub anonymous rate limit (100/h per IP) recovers.
# Stops a round as soon as a 429 is seen, so the quota is not burned by retries.
LOG=/home/vagrant/work/deploy/pull.log
IMAGES="free5gc/amf:v4.3.0 free5gc/ausf:v4.3.0 free5gc/udm:v4.3.0 free5gc/udr:v4.3.0 free5gc/pcf:v4.3.0 free5gc/smf:v4.3.0 free5gc/ueransim:v4.0.1 free5gc/bsf:v4.3.0 free5gc/chf:v4.3.0 free5gc/nef:v4.3.0"
pending="$IMAGES"
for attempt in $(seq 1 24); do
  still=""; limited=0
  for img in $pending; do
    if [ $limited -eq 1 ]; then still="$still $img"; continue; fi
    out=$(sudo k3s crictl pull docker.io/$img 2>&1)
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
      echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) OK   $img"
    else
      echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) FAIL $img: $(echo "$out" | tail -1)"
      still="$still $img"
      echo "$out" | grep -q "429\|Too Many Requests" && limited=1
    fi
  done
  pending="$still"
  if [ -z "$(echo $pending)" ]; then echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) ALL PULLED"; exit 0; fi
  echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) round $attempt done, pending:$still; sleeping 300s"
  sleep 300
done
echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) GIVE UP, still pending:$pending"
exit 1
EOF
chmod +x /home/vagrant/work/deploy/pull-images.sh && rm -f /home/vagrant/work/deploy/pull.log && echo written

  labels:

    component: gnb
data:
  gnb-config.yaml: |
    mcc: '208' # Mobile Country Code value
    mnc: '93'  # Mobile Network Code value (2 or 3 digits)
    nci: '0x000000010'  # NR Cell Identity (36-bit)
    idLength: 32        # NR gNB ID length in bits [22...32]
    tac: 1     # Tracking Area Code
    # List of supported S-NSSAIs by this gNB
    slices:
      - sst: 0x1
        sd: 0x010203
    # Indicates whether or not SCTP stream number errors should be ignored.
    ignoreStreamIds: true
    linkIp: GNB_POD_IP   # gNB's local IP address for Radio Link Simulation
    ngapIp: GNB_POD_IP   # gNB's local IP address for N2 Interface
    gtpIp: GNB_POD_IP    # gNB's local IP address for N3 Interface
    # List of AMF address information
    amfConfigs:
      - address: free5gc-free5gc-amf-amf-n2
        port: 38412
  wrapper.sh: |
    #!/bin/sh
    set -e
    # Dynamic Pod IP mode
    # Get Pod IP dynamically
    POD_IP=$(hostname -i | awk '{print $1}')
    echo "[gNB wrapper] Pod IP detected: $POD_IP"
    # Copy config to writable location
    cp /ueransim/config/gnb-config.yaml /tmp/gnb-config.yaml
    # Replace POD_IP placeholder
    sed -i "s/GNB_POD_IP/$POD_IP/g" /tmp/gnb-config.yaml
    echo "[gNB wrapper] Configuration prepared:"
    cat /tmp/gnb-config.yaml | grep -E "linkIp|ngapIp|gtpIp"
    # Execute gNB
    exec ./nr-gnb -c /tmp/gnb-config.yaml
---
          name: gnb-configmap
---

content.text:
UE 已成功註冊、建立 PDU session，並且能從 UE 的 `uesimtun0` 介面 ping 通 8.8.8.8（5 次 0% 丟包，RTT 約 10 ms）。

## (1) 部署了什麼、用了什麼設定

**free5GC v4.3.0**（chart：free5gc-helm commit `07139fc`，release `free5gc`，namespace `free5gc`）
- 核心 NF：NRF、AMF、AUSF、UDM、UDR、PCF、SMF、UPF（1 個）、NSSF、SCP、WebUI、BSF、CHF、NEF。N3IWF 和 dbpython 關閉。映像都是 `free5gc/*:v4.3.0`。
- MongoDB 7.0.9，使用 `local-path` 動態佈建 6Gi。
- 網路：全部在 K3s 的 Pod 網路（flannel 10.42.0.0/16）內，沒有用 Multus。

**UERANSIM v3.2.7**（chart：free5gc-helm `ueransim` 2.0.17，映像 `free5gc/ueransim:v4.0.1`，release `ueransim`）
- gNB 和 UE 各 1 個。

**設定**
- PLMN：MCC 208、MNC 93，TAC 1，NCI `0x000000010`
- Slice：SST 1、SD 010203
- DNN：`internet`，UE 地址池 10.60.0.0/16
- UE SUPI：`imsi-208930000000001`，K 與 OPc 採用 chart 預設值（free5GC 的標準測試金鑰）

**相對 chart 預設值的修改**（values 在 `/home/vagrant/work/deploy/values-free5gc.yaml`）
1. `userPlaneArchitecture: ulcl` → `single`，因為題目要 1 個 UPF。
2. UPF 的 `natIfCIDR`：預設 `192.168.0.0/16` 在這台機器上找不到網卡，UPF 會 CrashLoop。改成 Pod 網段 `10.42.0.0/16`。
3. MongoDB：chart 內寫死了 microk8s 的 PV（節點 `free5gc`、路徑 `/home/free5gc/mongodb`）。移除這個 PV，改用 `local-path`。

**Subscriber 佈建**：chart 內建的 dbpython 沒有部署，所以我直接用 mongosh 寫入 MongoDB（腳本在 `deploy/add-subscriber.js`、`fix-auth.js`、`fix-sqn.js`）。這裡要特別注意：repo 內 `add_subscribers.py` 的文件格式是舊版的，在 v4.3.0 下 UDM 解析會失敗。v4.3.0 的正確欄位是 `encPermanentKey`、`encOpcKey`，以及物件格式的 `sequenceNumber`（`sqn` / `sqnScheme` / `lastIndexes`）。這三項我是從 UDM 二進位檔的 JSON tag 確認的。

## (2) 怎麼確認網路是正確的

1. **叢集狀態**：所有 Pod 為 1/1 Running，`helm list` 顯示 `free5gc` rev 3、`ueransim` rev 1 為 deployed。
2. **NG Setup**：gNB 日誌顯示 `NG Setup procedure is successful`，AMF 日誌也有 `Send NG-Setup response`。
3. **註冊**：UE 日誌顯示 `Initial Registration is successful`，狀態 `MM-REGISTERED/NORMAL-SERVICE`。
4. **PDU session**：`PDU Session establishment is successful PSI[1]`，`uesimtun0` 取得 `10.60.0.1`。
5. **使用者面連通**：`ping -I uesimtun0 8.8.8.8`，5 次全部回應，0% 丟包，RTT 約 8–12 ms。
6. **確認流量經過 5G 核心**：ping 前後檢查 UPF 內 `upfgtp` 的計數，從 420 B / 5 封包增加到 672 B / 8 封包，符合 3 次 ping 的流量。

## 過程中遇到的問題

- **Docker Hub 匿名限流**：這台機器的出口 IP（140.113.110.82）額度用完（每小時 100 次），AMF、AUSF、UDM、UDR、PCF、SMF、UERANSIM 等映像一直拉不下來，延誤了大約一小時。我暫停了卡住的 Deployment，用背景腳本（`deploy/pull-images.sh`）每 5 分鐘重試，拉到後再恢復。ghcr.io 上沒有 free5GC 映像，無法替代。
- **UE 卡在 LIMITED-SERVICE**：UE 比 gNB 先啟動，錯過了後續的註冊流程。重啟 UE Pod 後正常。
- **Subscriber 格式錯誤**（見上文）：UDM 先後回報 `sequenceNumber` 型別錯誤、`Nil PermanentKey`，修正為 v4.3.0 的欄位格式後註冊成功。

## 尚未驗證 / 留意

- 我沒有驗證 Pod 重啟後的持久化（MongoDB 的資料是否能跨 Pod 保留），只確認了目前的運作。
- BSF、CHF、NEF 雖然用的是 chart 預設（已啟動），但對註冊與 PDU session 並非必要。
- 我在限流期間用 `kubectl scale` 暫停、恢復過 Deployment，但目前所有 Deployment 的副本數都是 1，與 Helm release 的設定一致。
